case_title.quote: STATE OF RAJASTHAN V. GIRDHARI LAL

number_of_accused.reason: Only the husband is tried in this appeal.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is the husband, so male.

offence_category.correct_value: Other (abetment of suicide, s.306 IPC); originally charged as dowry death
offence_category.quote: convicted him under Section 306 IPC instead of 304B IPC
offence_category.reason: Charged as dowry death, but the final established offence is abetment of suicide.

statutory_provisions.quote: a case under Section 304B and 498A IPC was registered
statutory_provisions.reason: Accurately reflects sections and the alteration to s.306.

weapon.correct_value: Burning (kerosene alleged in earlier incident); no weapon for the death
weapon.quote: tried to burn her alive by pouring kerosene
weapon.reason: Kerosene is mentioned for an earlier alleged attempt; 'None mentioned' ignores this.

evidence_type.reason: Medical, ocular and documentary evidence are noted.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: earlier tried to burn her alive by pouring kerosene

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted the respondent under Section 304-B IPC and sentenced him to undergo life imprisonment

high_court_outcome.quote: partly allowed the appeal, convicted the respondent under Section 306 IPC

offence_finally_established.quote: convicted him for the offence under Section 306 IPC

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the 'accused's family/in-laws' attribution details that are ambiguous; avoid implying postmortem facts beyond record.
neutral_facts.quote: Her in-laws were harassing Babita in connection with demand for dowry
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but says the accused's family harassed alongside the accused, and the apology is described loosely; minor drift.

offence_severity.reason: Punishment not stated in the judgment.

physical_harm.quote: There were burn injuries all over her body.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 2 charged (ss.304B and 498A registered, charge framed under 304B); 1 finally upheld (s.306)
number_of_offences.quote: a case under Section 304B and 498A IPC was registered
number_of_offences.reason: Registered under two sections; the charge framed was only 304B, so 1 charged is arguable.

motive.quote: It is not made specific as to whether Girdhari Lal demanded dowry.
motive.reason: Fairly captures the alleged dowry motive and the Court's finding.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Postmortem (Ext.P-6), PW.6, PW.1, PW.7, PW.8 and marriage date from PW.1, PW.3 and another villager
key_evidence_accepted.quote: Shyam Lal Mahajan, another resident of the Village Chhavsari
key_evidence_accepted.reason: PW.2 is not identified; the marriage-date witnesses are PW.1, PW.3 and Shyam Lal Mahajan.

witness_credibility.quote: It is not made specific as to whether Girdhari Lal demanded dowry.

post_offence_conduct.quote: respondent did not inform the parents of the deceased regarding the incident
post_offence_conduct.reason: Only the State's contention, not a finding; Not stated is acceptable.

custody_duration.quote: already undergone imprisonment for a period of more than six years

legal_representation.quote: Archana Pathak Dave, Milind Kumar for the Appellant. Satendar Sing Gulati, Kamaldeep Gulati for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: After the investigation chargesheet was filed.

appeal_history.quote: We find no merit in this appeal. The appeal is dismissed.

prosecution_argument.quote: the deceased-Babita died within 7 years of her marriage under unnatural circumstances

defence_argument.quote: supported the decision rendered by the High Court

legal_principle_applied.quote: the court may presume, having regard to all the other circumstances of the case

sentencing_rationale.quote: Hence, no interference is called for.
